sheet_pile.title: Sheet pile / shoring
sheet_pile.description: Embedment depth, moment and anchor force for cantilever or single-anchor sheet piles.
sheet_pile.list.subtitle: Sheet pile walls in the project.
sheet_pile.list.empty_desc: Create a sheet pile wall with “New wall”.
sheet_pile.detail.not_found_desc: The requested wall is not in the project or may have been deleted.
sheet_pile.create.title: New sheet pile wall
sheet_pile.create.note: If a profile is chosen, the soil is copied for this wall; the source profile is not changed.
sheet_pile.inputs.name: Name
sheet_pile.inputs.backfill_slope_hint: Empty = 0 (level). Must be below 45°; the analysis stops if β > φ′. The front side stays level.
sheet_pile.inputs.surcharge_basis_hint: Only matters on sloping ground. Horizontal projection: q is vertical per horizontal area; inclined surface: q / cos β.
sheet_pile.missing.range_backfill_slope: Backfill slope must be between 0° and 45°.
sheet_pile.inputs.sds_hint: If empty, no seismic case is run.
sheet_pile.inputs.allowable_stress_hint: If empty, the section modulus is not computed.
sheet_pile.soil.no_profiles_hint: The project has no soil profile; enter the soil manually.
sheet_pile.soil.copy_note: The chosen profile is copied for this wall; the source profile is preserved.
sheet_pile.missing.title: Missing inputs
sheet_pile.missing.name: Name is not entered.
sheet_pile.missing.layer_geometry: Layer {n}: top, bottom and γ are missing.
sheet_pile.missing.depth: The soil profile does not extend below the retained height.
sheet_pile.missing.range_retained_height: H must be greater than 0.5 m and at most 12 m.
sheet_pile.missing.range_anchor_depth: Anchor depth must be at least 0 m and less than H.
sheet_pile.missing.range_surcharge: Surcharge must be at least 0 kPa.
sheet_pile.missing.range_sds: S_DS must be greater than 0 and less than 3.
sheet_pile.missing.range_allowable_stres: Allowable stress must be greater than 0 MPa.
sheet_pile.missing.range_gwt: Groundwater depth must be at least 0 m.
sheet_pile.missing.range_depth: The deepest layer bottom must be below H (the dredge line).
sheet_pile.missing.range_layer_geometry: Layer {n}: bottom must be below top; the first top is 0 m and each next top must meet the previous bottom (within 0.001 m).
sheet_pile.missing.range_layer_gamma: Layer {n}: unit weight γ must be greater than 5 and less than 30 kN/m³.
sheet_pile.detail.stale_desc: The source profile changed after the copy; results may be out of date.
sheet_pile.detail.soil_manual: Soil entered manually for this wall.
sheet_pile.job.unavailable: This job is no longer available; run the design again.
sheet_pile.result.title: Design result
sheet_pile.result.mock_note: Synthetic sample values; not a real calculation.
sheet_pile.result.section_missing: No allowable stress entered, so no section modulus.
sheet_pile.detail.result_stale: Inputs changed; the displayed result may be out of date.
sheet_pile.detail.source_stale_title: Source soil profile is out of date
sheet_pile.result.series_toe_note: The series ends at the theoretical toe (H + D₀), not at the total length.
sheet_pile.job.resume_hint: If polling stops, reload this page; the ?job= URL resumes the job status.
sheet_pile.detail.result_stale_title: Result may be out of date
sheet_pile.warning.override_not_applied: Factor override {path} is accepted but not applied yet: the engine does not use material factors on unit weight.
sheet_pile.warning.sheet_pile.embedment_: Design embedment extends below the soil profile
sheet_pile.warning.sheet_pile.tension_cr: Tension zone to {depth} m set to zero (tension crack)
sheet_pile.warning.sheet_pile.cohesion_i: Layer {layer}: c′ ignored by the {method} solution
sheet_pile.warning.sheet_pile.steep_seis: Layer {layer}: TBDY Eq. 16.24b (β > φ′ − ψ) applied.
sheet_pile.warning.sheet_pile.passive_co: Layer {layer}: Coulomb passive with δ > φ/2 is unconservative
sheet_pile.warning.sheet_pile.anchor_loa: Anchor load: {load} kN per anchor (spacing {spacing} m, inclination {inclination}°)
sheet_pile.warning.sheet_pile.mock: Synthetic result; not an engineering calculation.
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.default: No design approach was selected; the first approach {approach} of the code was used.
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.layered: Layered Rankine active/passive pressure; separate front/retained profiles and groundwater; hydrostatic water; no seepage
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.passive: Passive pressure divided by FS={factor}; where smaller, the passive pressure from tan φ′ and c′ divided by FS is used (high φ′; USACE EM 1110-2-2504 5-2d)
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.support: Cantilever Blum embedment increased by {percent}%; free-earth support for anchored walls
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.front_w: Front groundwater overridden to {depth} m below the top; the same level is used for design and seismic cases
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.seismic: r={r}; KDYY handbook seismic increment: uniform 0.5 dK_ad sigma'v(toe) over the wall length 0..toe plus a triangular surcharge part 2 q dK_ad (1 - z/toe), toe depth found by iteration; passive M-O/Rankine ratio at most {passive_ratio_max} per layer; undrained seismic analysis stopped; no hydrodynamic or excess pore pressure
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.governi: Embedment and toe force: {embedment}; moment, curves and section modulus: {moment}; anchor force: case envelope.
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.anchor_: Anchor load = wall force × spacing / cos(inclination); spacing {spacing} m, inclination {inclination}°
sheet_pile.inputs.advanced: Advanced: design code, anchor and front-side water
sheet_pile.inputs.approach_hint: Optional; leave empty for the service default.
sheet_pile.inputs.depth_increase_hint: Service default: {value}. Leave unchanged to use it.
sheet_pile.inputs.front_water_depth_hint: Empty uses the soil profile front water level.
sheet_pile.missing.range_depth_increase: Embedment increase must be at least 0.
sheet_pile.missing.range_anchor_spacing: Anchor spacing must be greater than 0 m.
sheet_pile.missing.range_anchor_inclinat: Anchor inclination must be at least 0° and less than 90°.
sheet_pile.missing.range_front_water_dep: Front water depth must be at least 0 m.
sheet_pile.warning.sheet_pile.slope_cohe: Layer {layer}: c′ ignored on sloping backfill (Rankine solution, conservative)
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.backfil: Sloping backfill β = {beta}°: Rankine slope coefficient (resultant parallel to the surface), front side horizontal; c′ ignored on sloping ground; seismic M-O (δ = β) stops when β > φ′ − ψ
sheet_pile.assumption.sheet_pile.surchar: Surcharge given per inclined surface area; q / cos β on the horizontal projection (q = {q} kPa, β = {beta}°)
sheet_pile.diagram.note: Depth z is measured from the pile top; the plot ends at the theoretical toe (H + D₀).
sheet_pile.result.toe_force_hint: Absolute value; acts towards the excavation.
sheet_pile.detail.save_blocked: Structure inputs are incomplete or out of range; they were not saved and the project file was not written.
sheet_pile.detail.gw_title: Groundwater used in the calculation (depth below ground, m)
sheet_pile.result.toe_note: The embedment follows from moment equilibrium. A force of {value} kN/m remains unbalanced at the toe; the embedment increase covers it.
sheet_pile.detail.no_result_desc: Fill in the inputs and save, then run the design.
